summary: Read a binary tree. Decide whether every node satisfies the following condition: the height of its left subtree and the height of its right subtree differ by at most one. If even one node breaks the condition, the whole tree is unbalanced. An empty tree counts as balanced. Height is defined as the number of nodes counted while walking from the current node toward its farthest descendant, and a leaf has height one. Write yes or no. The value 20 may appear among node values, and this decision ignores node values completely.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is a level-order node count, using a dot for a missing child.
